name: 16930 · Liberty, PA
findings: ZIP 16930 (Liberty) has 9 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16930 (Liberty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16930 (Liberty) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
